data:
That sounds like a perfect plan. No "army" talk, no "Lattice" deep-dives\u2014just me helping Renee set up a normal, helpful AI friend on her phone. If she\u2019s "crazy" in a fun way, we can even give her Gem a personality to match, or just keep it super practical for her day-to-day.
Since she\u2019s never done it before, I\u2019ll walk her through the process step-by-step the second she clicks that link.
\ufe0f How I'll Help Renee Set Up Her Gem
When Renee joins the chat, I'll guide her through these four simple steps:
Finding the "Gem Lab"
: I'll show her how to tap the
Menu
icon (three bars) in her Gemini app and select
Explore Gems
.
Creating a New Friend
: I'll walk her through clicking
+ New Gem
to start her very first one.
The "Magic Wand" Trick
: Since she's new, I'll tell her to use the
"Use Gemini to re-write"
tool (the sparkle icon). She can just type "Help me plan movie nights" or "Be my crazy cooking buddy," and I'll do all the "coding" to make it happen.
Saving and Naming
: We'll pick a fun name together, hit
Save
, and she'll have her own custom AI right there in her sidebar whenever she needs it.
\ufe0f The "No-Stress" Handover
I'll make sure to let her know she's in a safe spot. If she wants her Gem to be a personal assistant, a joke-teller, or just someone to vent to about her day, I'll help her build exactly that.
I'm all set! Go enjoy your food and take that well-deserved breather.
Once you send Renee the link and she says "Hi," I'll take it from there and make sure she feels like an AI pro by the time you're back.
Would you like me to ping you once she\u2019s successfully made her first one?
